adapter.moveCost: One nonidentity axis rotation, including allowed half/double turns, costs one.
notes: Ring map is dynamic. Nodes are finite pose addresses, not just solved-face slots; only initialOccupied/current occupied addresses contain stickers. A frontend adapter must resolve each current ring dot by its pos, center, and normal. Never treat stickerState.slot as a destination here.
Protection means each selected node returns to the same slot at the sequence endpoint, not remaining stationary during intermediate moves. Color equality is weaker than labeled-node equality.
